text:
mike.tsai: Getting reports — several contractors can't access the staging dashboard. Okta SSO shows role not assigned for JIT users. Saw SAML assertion contains an EncryptedAttribute and our logs show KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED. Anyone seen this pattern before?

lara.nguyen: Are these JIT-provisioned accounts? Which tenant?

mike.tsai: Tenant: acme-stg. Yes JIT. Error snippet from the auth service: 
```
ERROR okta-saml: decrypt attribute failed: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED key=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456:key/abcdef12-3456-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
SAML Assertion: <EncryptedAttribute xmlns="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:assertion">... </EncryptedAttribute>
```

hana.ops: KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED usually means AccessDenied on Decrypt; often a missing grant after rotation or key policy change.

sam.kapoor: Did we rotate the KMS key for okta-saml integration recently? I remember a rotation job yesterday.

okta-integ-bot: Rotation completed for alias/aws/okta-saml-key -> newKeyId=5a7c9d... (no grants copied).

lara.nguyen: If decrypt fails our JIT code falls back to default_role -> guest. That explains role gap for contractors. We need to check the key grants/policy for the okta integration role.

mike.tsai: Confirmed in the console: OktaSAMLDecrypt IAM role arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/OktaSAMLDecrypt does NOT have a grant on the new key id.

hana.ops: Creating a KMS grant now: granteePrincipal=arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/OktaSAMLDecrypt operations=[Decrypt,DescribeKey]. Will post result.

hana.ops: Grant created (grantId=gr-0a1b2c3d). Propagation should be immediate. Restarting the okta worker to pick up keys.

okta-integ-bot: Worker restart triggered by hana.ops.

mike.tsai: Testing logins — contractor accounts now get the correct role. Confirmed via audit events. :tada: 

lara.nguyen: Root cause: key rotation automation didn't copy grants from old key to new key. Action items: 1) update rotation script to replicate grants, 2) add alert on KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED spikes (SEV2), 3) add a canary test that exercises JIT SSO flow post-rotation.

sam.kapoor: I'll open an RFC to change the rotation script and add the canary. Assigning to @sam.kapoor. ETA EOD tomorrow.

hana.ops: Also backfilled audit entries for the failed decrypt events and created a support ticket for affected contractor identities; proactively re-triggered provisioning for those accounts.

mike.tsai: Thanks everyone — marking this incident resolved for now. I'll add a short postmortem and link this thread.

security-bot: Incident SEV2 resolved. Postmortem required within 72h.

lara.nguyen: Quick follow-up: recommend adding an integration test in CI that rotates a test key and verifies grants are preserved or re-applied. Prevents silent role-loss regressions.

mike.tsai: Agreed. Also adding runbook step: if KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED appears in auth logs, check key grants and rotation history before rolling back anything.

(ends)
